name: Gravity Booking – Appointment Booking Plugin for Gravity Forms
author: Saad Iqbal

sections.description:
Gravity Booking transforms your Gravity Forms into a full-featured appointment booking and scheduling system. Let clients book services, staff, or resources in real time — accept online payments, sync with calendars, manage availability, and more. All inside WordPress.

Suitable for clinics, salons, coaches, rental services, fitness trainers, corporate teams, and any service provider that needs automated scheduling inside Gravity Forms.

Key Features

  • Unlimited booking rules for services, locations, staff, and time slots
  • Build booking forms using native Gravity Fields & conditional logic
  • Google Calendar sync (one or two-way) & Outlook 365 integration
  • Multi-location + multi-staff management
  • Custom schedules — holidays, breaks, time zones
  • Accept online payments using Gravity Forms gateways (Stripe, Square, Mollie, etc.)
  • Full-day & timed bookings, capacity control, step-by-step booking flows
  • Export bookings to PDF/CSV
  • Add-to-Calendar option for customers (ICS)
  • RTL support + mobile responsive forms
  • Works seamlessly inside WordPress admin

Why Choose Gravity Booking

  • Customers book 24/7 without manual scheduling
  • Reduce no-shows with email notifications & calendar events
  • Prevent double-bookings via sync with Google/Outlook
  • Designed for scalability — multiple services, staff & locations
  • Fully customizable via Gravity Forms (no rigid booking templates)

Pro Features

  • Multiple Staff
  • Location
  • Google Calendar
  • Outlook Calendar

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0+
  • Gravity Forms installed & active
  • SSL certificate recommended for payment handling
sections.installation:
1. Upload the gravity-booking.zip file via Plugins → Add New → Upload.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Follow the full configuration guide: https://gravitybooking.com/install-and-configure-gravity-forms-booking/
sections.faq:
What is Gravity Booking?

A booking & appointment system built as a Gravity Forms add-on.

Does it require Gravity Forms?

Yes — booking forms are created using Gravity Forms fields.

Can I accept payments?

Yes — online payments work through Gravity Forms gateways like Stripe, Square, Mollie, etc.

Does it sync with Google Calendar / Outlook?

Yes — available in Pro, including one-way or two-way synchronization.
